items.headline: Constellation Brands reports Q1 CY2026 results: revenue down 11.3% YoY, issues below-consensus full-year guidance
Constellation Brands Q1 beat on EPS but soft consumer trends and weaker outlook pressure shares and guidance for FY2027
Roth Capital and other analysts reiterate Buy ratings on Constellation Brands after Q1 beat, citing improving fundamentals and upside to guidance
